scope: R2.4 replay-case evidence for the build-2 source, established by structural inheritance from the executed 2026-07-28 TradingView replay plus repository execution of the inserted shadow transport; not server-alert delivery evidence

canonicalSource.hashScheme: sha256 over freeze_library_pin(source) -- refresh-invariant, identical to the contract buildHistory scheme

inheritance.claim: Build 2 differs from the TradingView-replayed build 1 by exactly one pure insertion below section 8b (the shadow alert() transport), after the last alertcondition. Zero lines of build 1 were modified or removed, so every decision path the 20 replay cases executed on 2026-07-28 is byte-identical in build 2 and the case results inherit.

structuralBridge.verification: Remove the recorded insert block from the frozen build-2 source and the sha256 of the remainder must equal basisFrozenSha256. Re-executed on every test run by tests/test_smc_hold_manager_replay.py::test_the_structural_bridge_reproduces_build_one_from_the_tree.

executedForTheDelta.claim: The inserted transport itself is not covered by inheritance and is executed directly from the repository: the payload renderer parses hm_shadow_payload out of the Pine source and validates every channel payload against the receiver's wire model, and the alert() bar-close gate is enforced over the whole Pine population.
executedForTheDelta.limitation: Repository execution of the renderer is not execution evidence from the Pine runtime; the first live edge delivered through the receiver closes that gap and is recorded in the shadow ledger, not here.
